cd /workspace && timeout 400 python3 - << 'EOF'
import random, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/deps')
import networkx as nx

rng = random.Random(1)
nreq, noff, npairs = 4096, 8192, 262144
G = nx.DiGraph()
SRC, SNK = '@s', '@t'
G.add_node(SRC, demand=-4096); G.add_node(SNK, demand=4096)
groups_rq = ['q0','q1','q2','q3']
groups_of = {}
for i in range(4):
    G.add_node(('rq', groups_rq[i]), demand=0)
G.add_edge(SRC, ('rq','q0'), capacity=4096, weight=0)
G.add_edge(SRC, ('rq','q1'), capacity=4096, weight=0)
G.add_edge(SRC, ('rq','q2'), capacity=4096, weight=0)
G.add_edge(SRC, ('rq','q3'), capacity=4096, weight=0)
for i in range(nreq):
    g = rng.choice(groups_rq)
    G.add_edge(('rq', g), ('r', i), capacity=1, weight=0)
    groups_of[i] = g
for j in range(noff):
    G.add_edge(('o', j), ('oq', rng.choice(['p0','p1','p2','p3'])), capacity=4096, weight=0)
for g in ['p0','p1','p2','p3']:
    G.add_edge(('oq', g), SNK, capacity=4096, weight=0)
for k in range(npairs):
    i = k % nreq
    j = (k * 7919) % noff
    G.add_edge(('r', i), ('o', j), capacity=1, weight=rng.randrange(0, 10**9))
print('graph built', G.number_of_nodes(), G.number_of_edges())
t = time.time()
cost, flow = nx.network_simplex(G, demand='demand', capacity='capacity', weight='weight')
print('network_simplex:', cost, 'time', time.time()-t)
